name: TC2 — Multiple line items on one invoice
description:
Verifies the "single invoice can consist of multiple line items" requirement: posts one invoice containing 3 distinct line items and confirms every item persists.

**Endpoint:** POST /invoice-webhook/api/v1/invoices
**Expected:** HTTP 200 with body {"status":"accepted"}, then exactly 3 rows in staging.pg_invoice_items for this invoice number.
